body.purpose: Inherited body role; task and document surfaces use their explicit sizes.

motion.name: action-card
motion.purpose: Task-card hover; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: button-states
motion.value: background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Explicit task action; secondary is the shared Button default.
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;background:var(--primary,#181818);color:var(--primary-foreground,#fff);font:500 .875rem/1.7 var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans KR",sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms ease,color 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:var(--brand,#49144f)}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#49144f);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-button-primary:disabled{background:var(--surface-muted,#efebf0);color:#7c727f;pointer-events:none}

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: Explicit task action; secondary is the shared Button default.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:8px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d2ccd4);border-radius:12px;background:var(--secondary,#f4f1f5);color:var(--text,#181818);font:500 .875rem/1.7 var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans KR",sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms ease,color 180ms ease,transform 180ms ease}.ds-button-secondary:hover{background:var(--accent,#f6e1ef)}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#49144f);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button-secondary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{background:var(--surface-muted,#efebf0);color:#7c727f;pointer-events:none}

components.name: Labeled input
components.description: Shared field with visible focus and invalid state.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-search">자료 검색</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-search" placeholder="제목이나 내용을 입력하세요">
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;color:var(--text,#181818);font:500 .875rem/1.7 var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans KR",sans-serif)}.ds-input{width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:8px 20px;border:1px solid var(--input,#86798a);border-radius:12px;background:var(--field-background,#faf9fb);color:var(--text,#181818);font:.875rem/1.7 var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans KR",sans-serif);caret-color:var(--brand,#49144f)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#655d68)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#49144f);outline-offset:4px}.ds-input:focus-visible{border-color:var(--ring,#49144f);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--ring,#49144f) 50%,transparent)}.ds-input[aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:var(--error,#b42342)}.ds-input:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Reference document card
components.description: A document surface with a separate explicit open action.
components.html:
학습 레퍼런스

내 설명과 근거를 함께 정리합니다.

문서 열기
components.css: .ds-document{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:start;gap:16px;padding:24px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--panel,#fff);color:var(--text,#181818);font:.875rem/1.7 var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans KR",sans-serif)}.ds-document h2{font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:600;margin:12px 0 8px}.ds-document p{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted,#655d68);margin:8px 0;line-height:1.65}.ds-document a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d2ccd4);border-radius:12px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit;background:var(--panel,#fff)}.ds-document a:hover{background:var(--surface-muted,#efebf0)}.ds-document a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#49144f);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-document{padding:20px}}

components.name: Resume surface
components.description: Real learning title, timestamp and an explicit continuation action.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-resume{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:start;justify-content:center;min-height:268px;padding:28px;border-radius:22px;background:var(--brand,#49144f);color:#fff;font:.875rem/1.7 var(--font-sans,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Noto Sans KR",sans-serif)}.ds-resume h2{font-size:1.65rem;line-height:1.4;max-width:32ch;margin:16px 0 8px}.ds-resume p{color:#f2deef;margin:0 0 22px;font-size:.85rem;line-height:1.65}.ds-resume a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:var(--brand,#49144f);font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}.ds-resume a:hover{background:var(--accent,#f6e1ef)}.ds-resume a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring,#49144f);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-resume{min-height:234px;padding:24px;border-radius:20px}.ds-resume h2{font-size:1.4rem}}

narrative.overview: Light gray surroundings and white work surfaces expose learning tasks through reusable labeled components. Plum identifies learning focus, pink supplies context, and black carries primary actions. The original Code Trainer system sans serves both Korean interface text and readable documents. This is a code-led replacement system, not a claim of comp approval.
keyCharacteristics: Light workspace with dark detailed code editor

rules.name: The Action and Context Rule
rules.body: Black marks primary action or destination; plum and pale pink identify context. Preserve labels and written state.

rules.name: The Reading Measure Rule
rules.body: Shared reading copy stops at 72ch; lesson articles and reference chapters use 74ch.

rules.name: The Floating Layer Rule
rules.body: Keep work cards flat; use shadows for floating menus, the dock and question capture.

dos: Do keep problem books and practice visible in Materials.
Do preserve focus, labels and safe-area spacing.
Do distinguish user writing, evidence and AI explanation.
donts: Don't restore the rejected serif and gold system.
Don't use dashboards or management tables as the main learning composition.
Don't add decorative eyebrows or duplicate labels.
Don't imply real-device or paid-AI validation from synthetic browser renders.
